open_questions: Semantics of fn_0807b840/fn_0807b8ae (thread parent id / kill) and the notify/endon bookkeeping callees (0x0807c6f8,0x0807c740,0x0807c76a,0x0807c794,0x0807b5fc,0x08082a92) are inferred from CoD4 only.
Opcodes 0x66..0x75 are labelled positionally; 0x77/0x78 share one handler (waittill vs waittillmatch unresolved).
Roles of scrVarPub_notifyArrayId (0x08397520), scrVarPub_freeEntList (0x08397530) and the unnamed counters cleared in Scr_Init (0x08205640,0x08205a58,0x08205c88..0x08205c94) are unknown.
